The predicate is `isEnabled(flag, ctx)`, defined in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. I verified every reference to it across the repo, distinguishing genuine direct invocations from decoys: context-builders (`buildFlagContext`, `orgFlagContext`), the precomputed-snapshot wrapper `readFlag` (called by `FeatureGate` and `useFeatureFlag`, which despite their doc comments never call `isEnabled` themselves), and the pure registry/type files that only mention it in comments.

Two internal wrapper functions inside the defining file — `snapshotFlags` and `assertEnabled` — also contain genuine call sites (`isEnabled(key, ctx)` / `isEnabled(flag, ctx)`), the same pattern as the legitimate fallback calls inside `src/config/nav.ts` (`flagAllows`) and `src/hooks/flag-context.ts` (`readFlag`), so all three of those files are included as callers.
